{{Quote|I dropped some credits and think I got some real answers, but they know very little. It happened a few hours ago. The housekeeper droid apparently took a scrambler hit and saw nothing. There's no sign of violence and there was no ransom note left behind. She broadcast a brief panic signal, but it went out after less than a minute.|Stavin Thaal's driver on Ledina Chott|<ref name="MK" />}}
This ''' individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] in the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite unit of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]], and served as the [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] driver of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]], head of the Galactic Alliance Army and founder of the Pop-Dogs.<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, infiltrated the home of the famous [[Musician/Legends|singer]] [[Ledina Chott]] in [[Tiara Ridge estates]] on the  [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. After disabling her [[Housekeeping droid/Legends|housekeeping droid]], [[Twelve-String]], with a [[Scrambler/Legends|scrambler]], they waited for Chott to return home before abducting her.<ref name="MK" />

Thaal, who's been secretly courting Chott with gifts for [[Standard month|months]], arrived a block away from her home two [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after her abduction. By then, the [[Kura City Guard]] had surrounded the residence as part of its investigation. Remaining inside his [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], Thaal sent his driver to gather information. The driver attempted to obtain details by offering [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to bystanders before returning to the airspeeder. Thaal then decided to return to his base to determine what had happened.<ref name="MK" />

The next [[Standard day|day]], the Wraiths sprung their trap on Thaal as he attempted to halt the investigation being conducted by the Kura City Guard at the [[Major Saving's Army Surplus]], which served as the entrance to the hidden base where he stored his illicit black market goods. Adding to his troubles, troops and military police from [[Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command|Starfighter Command]] joined the investigation under the leadership of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Kadana Sorrel]]. As Thaal attempted to persuade Sorrel to leave the investigation to him, a droid equipped with a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] approached the pair and began displaying the image of [[Ton Phanan]], a member of Wraith Squadron previously thought to be [[Death/Legends|dead]]. Thaal's driver immediately placed herself between the droid and Thaal and drew her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to protect her superior. Phanan, who was actually [[Turman Durra]] impersonating the deceased Wraith, informed Sorrel that Thaal was already dead and the person she was speaking to was an impostor. Incensed, Thaal ordered his driver to shut down the holoprojector, but before she could shoot it, one of the military police struck her wrist with his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|rifle]], causing her to drop her blaster.<ref name="MK" />

==Skills and abilities==
Stavin Thaal's driver was capable of driving an airspeeder. Thaal suspected that she was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] with limited chauffeuring experience since her quick, minute course adjustments kept jerking Thaal from his seat.<ref name="MK" />
